composition.scope: Real project groups and exposure/review status are declared metadata, not external attestations. Tasks, captures and repeats are not independent websites. Public or previously inspected cases are not unseen holdout evidence.

analyzer.scope: Source and parser-lock identities, not proof that a declared corpus was unseen. Enhanced analysis uses the explicitly configured parser; this record does not claim OS sandboxing or a model comparison.

metric_scope: Precision/recall count method/path identities from the first repetition. Strict case scores also require confidence, evidence kinds and any labeled locations. Empty precision, recall and F1 denominators are null. All repetitions must have identical scored projections.
